$comment: Initial JS per route in kB gzip (scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs, F15.2): the entry chunk, the route's lazy chunk, every chunk they import statically, and any worker/asset script one of those chunks starts eagerly (MapLibre's worker). Compressed at gzip level 1, the nginx default frontend/nginx.conf actually serves at (it sets gzip on without gzip_comp_level) -- not level 9, which under-reports by roughly 10-15%. Budgets are the measured size at S0-FE plus about 10% headroom; lower them when a stream makes a route lighter. `target` records the intended budget once the named work lands.

/search.target: F15.1 (S2-SEARCH): load MapLibre (chunk + worker) only when the map is opened; list view <= 130 kB

/listings/new.target: S3-SUPPLY wizard: load the map picker (chunk + worker) on the location step only; <= 140 kB
